messages:
Marcos: quick sync — we need a minimal, auditable fast-failover plan for resident-region writes. goals: preserve data residency, avoid split-brain, and make decisions automatable where safe.

Olivia: propose requirement: tenant explicit opt-in + control-plane health + per-tenant replication lag under threshold. Default: no cross-region failover.

Devin: define replication lag signal. Prefer kv_replication_lag_ms (apply-to-commit), not WAL ack.

Kai: export kv_replication_lag_ms per tenant+region (p50/p95/p99), plus last_write_region and last_write_ts. Need <1s metric latency.

sre-bot: alert: eu-west-1 packet loss 6.7% at 14:03 UTC — rising tail latency.

Anna: legal: cannot auto-promote EU-resident tenants to non-EU unless tenant opts in. Audit log required for any cross-region promotion (retain 1y).

Marcos: protocol sketch: tenant config fields (resident_region, allow_cross_region_failover=false, failover_replication_lag_ms=500, max_auto_failover_qps=50). Signals: controlplane_healthy, kv_replication_lag_ms, probe_connectivity_ok, last_write_region. Steps: detect -> preprobe candidate -> verify lag & probes -> short freeze-window -> atomic route flip -> post-check audit sweep.

Devin: freeze-window risky at high QPS; simulate impact.

Kai: gate autos to max_auto_failover_qps, require manual ops for high-QPS tenants.

Priya: action: need faster telemetry pipeline; current ~3s too slow.

Marcos: AIs: Kai: exporter prototype (Fri); Olivia: RFC draft (Tue); Devin: freeze-window sims (Wed); Anna: compliance wording (Thu EOD).

Olivia: appendix: operator-override TTL + forced-revert playbook.

Marcos: will file RFC with state machine and observability contract. Ping when ready. :thumbsup:
